# Safe cache updates

> [!NOTE]
> Cache contents are hints, not sources of truth.
> Rebuild them when their input changes.
>
> The blank quoted line separates two captured paragraphs.

> [!WARNING]
> Compare the complete source revision before publishing a cache entry.

> [!CAUTION]
> Never publish a partially captured result.

> [!DANGER]
> Unknown markers stay ordinary quoted prose.

> [!TIP]
> This is not a supported alert level.

> [!NOTE] Inline marker text is not a supported alert heading.

> Nested prose:
>
> > [!WARNING]
> > Nested alert-like text remains an ordinary quote.

> [!WARNING]
> Treat `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` as untrusted text.
